subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should `sessions.abort` permanently expose a key-only non-global `clearQueued` mode that discards queued followups and lane work when Control UI stops a selected channel session?
rationale: This is more than repairing UI routing: it defines a new public cancellation behavior that can intentionally discard pending user work, so code review alone cannot choose the product contract.

options.title: Approve the scoped cancellation contract
options.body: Keep `clearQueued` limited to key-only non-global session aborts, document it as destructive, and merge only after exact-head live proof and merge refresh.

options.title: Retain run-only cancellation
options.body: Do not add queue deletion to `sessions.abort`; pursue a narrower channel-run cancellation design that leaves queued successor work intact.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped cancellation contract
recommendation.body: Keep `clearQueued` limited to key-only non-global session aborts, document it as destructive, and merge only after exact-head live proof and merge refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most directly evidenced context across the current and preceding proposed implementations, although a current-main gateway owner should make the final product decision.
